parts.notes: Shipped code predates Docs/FRONTEND-STACK.md (authoritative target). Uses legacy fetch/FontAwesome/Tailwind v4/CSS Modules; no tests.
Single app 'organizer'. Cookie-based JWT auth via JWTAuthCookieMiddleware. Google OAuth2 + YouTube Data API v3. No tests. DEBUG/SECRET_KEY hardcoded (dev-only).

integration_points.details: GET /api/auth/google/, /api/auth/me/, /api/youtube/playlists/, /api/oauth2callback/. CORS origin https://localhost:3000, credentials enabled.
OAuth2 code exchange, userinfo fetch, youtube.playlists().list. Tokens persisted in UserSocialToken.
auth_user, organizer_usersocialtoken, django_session. Env-driven connection (POSTGRES_*, host=db).
